text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (June 11, 2024) for 1570 Lawrence Avenue West

The Property Standards Committee - Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (June 11, 2024) for 1570 Lawrence Avenue West, Folder Number 24 162884 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to January 3, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
